name: data-grid-presence-demo
title: Data Grid Presence Demo
author: gridcn
description: 3 simulated users move cell/range selections on a timer via useDataGridPresence's setPresenceHighlights (2 in view-space range form, 1 rowId-native), with toolbar avatar chips, one user periodically overlapping another, and headerClickBehavior="sort" proving the rowId-native highlight follows its row through a sort.
